newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev ends mostly unchanged near 234 to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev ends mostly unchanged near 234 to dlr.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 234.00/20 per dollar, in the midst of 233.50-234.50 morning spread due to dollar sales by the central bank and several commercial banks, dealers said.

"A rise in dollar supply stabilised the lev around 234 to the dollar for most of the day. This is down some two levs from Wednesday's close due to the longer value date of today's spot deals" a commercial bank dealer said.
The lev closed at 232.00/20 per dollar on Wednesday. @
The current spread between interest rates on lev-denominated and dollar-denominated investments allows for a daily lev's fall by some 0.7 levs to the dollar.

The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) sold dollars for final clients at 233.30-233.50 levs in the morning but withdrew from the market in the afternoon and the lev eased to 234.50/60 in sporadic deals, traders said.
It rebounded to 234 in late afternoon as dollar demand subsided. @

According to dealers some commercial banks also offered foreign currency due to a sharp lev liquidity shortage, which contributed to the lev's relative stability in today's trade. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
